proof_body:
by
  intro a q n hq hn h
  have hn0 : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : n ≠ 0 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hq0 : (q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : q ≠ 0 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, m, hkm⟩ p hp hpq
    have h1 : (a : ℚ) * (n : ℚ) ^ k = m * q := by
      field_simp at hkm
      linarith
    have h2 : a * (n : ℤ) ^ k = m * q := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h3 : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * (n : ℤ) ^ k := ⟨m, by rw [h2]; ring⟩
    have h4 : IsCoprime (q : ℤ) a := (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr h).symm
    have h5 : (q : ℤ) ∣ (n : ℤ) ^ k := h4.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h3
    have h6 : q ∣ n ^ k := by exact_mod_cast h5
    exact hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (hpq.trans h6)
  · intro hp
    have key : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ q → p ∣ n) → ∃ k, q ∣ n ^ k := by
      intro q
      induction q using induction_on_primes with
      | zero => intro h0; omega
      | one => intro _ _; exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      | prime_mul p a hp' ih =>
        intro h0 hall
        have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left h0 |> fun x => x
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih ha (fun r hr hra => hall r hr (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hra p))
        refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
        rw [pow_succ']
        exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul (hall p hp' (Dvd.intro a rfl)) hk
    obtain ⟨k, s, hs⟩ := key q hq hp
    refine ⟨k, a * s, ?_⟩
    have h1 : (n : ℚ) ^ k = q * s := by exact_mod_cast hs
    have hs0 : (s : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at h1
      exact pow_ne_zero k hn0 h1
    rw [h1]
    push_cast
    field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a : ℤ) (q n : ℕ), 0 < q → 2 ≤ n → Int.gcd a q = 1 → ((∃ (k : ℕ) (m : ℤ), (a : ℚ) / q = m / (n : ℚ) ^ k) ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ q → p ∣ n)
